slides.headline: ChatGPT just got *13 new voices*. Here's how to switch yours in three taps

slides.heading: Step 1: *Update the app*
paras: OpenAI started rolling out GPT-Live-1.1 in ChatGPT Voice on October 15, with more natural accents and new voices.
Update the ChatGPT app first. The rollout is gradual, so some accounts still show the old voices for now.

slides.heading: Step 2: *Open Voice settings*
paras: Go to Settings, then Voice, then Voice. That screen lists every voice your account can use.
Under Settings and Voice you can also set the language and pick a mode: Live, Advanced or Standard.

slides.heading: Step 3: *Pick a new voice*
paras: New options cover French, German, Hindi, Japanese, Korean and Mexican Spanish, plus a new English voice called Bubbie.
German gets Sonna and Miko. OpenAI says the voices you see may vary by region and account.

slides.heading: How long *you can talk*
paras: Plus gets 3 hours of GPT-Live-1.1 per rolling 24 hours. Pro gets 15 hours on the $100 plan and no hour cap on the $200 plan.

paras.t: Free and Go users get the smaller GPT-Live-1.1 Quip. Go gets 3 hours, Free gets limited use.

slides.hook: Try a new ChatGPT voice today, and follow for more AI tips you can use right away.
